item.title: [CRITICAL] CISA KEV Alert: CVE-2026-133968 in Project MONAI MONAI Label Under Active Exploitation
item.description: Project MONAI MONAI Label is affected by CVE-2026-133968. Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution. Required Remediation: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendo... Action: Mandatory remediation: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines. Check retail perimeter and server inventory for MONAI Label.
